episodes.title: Inside the Palmarian "catholic" Church: The Cult Behind the Walls
episodes.description:
The Fake Pope and the Palmarian Catholic Cult

It started with alleged apparitions of the Virgin Mary in a small Spanish village.

It ended with its own popes, its own version of Catholicism, a fortified cathedral compound and one former leader returning years later under circumstances almost impossible to believe.

In this episode of The Doctrine, Josh Rosa investigates the extraordinary history of the Palmarian Catholic Church and the men who claimed that the true papacy no longer existed in Rome but in El Palmar de Troya, Spain.

We trace the movement from the alleged Marian apparitions of 1968 through the rise of Clemente Domínguez, his transformation into the self proclaimed Pope Gregory XVII, the movement's increasingly isolated religious world and the eventual defection of Gregory XVIII.

But underneath the bizarre history is a much more important question.

How does religious conviction become religious control?
This is more than the story of a fake pope.

It's a story about certainty, fear, authority and what can happen when questioning the person claiming to speak for God becomes almost impossible.



Cult, Cults, Fake Church.
